deviations.text: Plugin-off settings: a second, synced plugin copy (orchestrai@synced v2.0.1) still loaded with only orchestrai@orchestrai disabled. Every arm and judge session used --settings with both orchestrai@orchestrai and orchestrai@synced set false.
Judge GH_CONFIG_DIR: protocol section 8.5 sets it outside env -i, where it would be dropped; at judging it went inside ENV_WRAP instead.
Clone URL: clones used the repo's https remote, not the ssh URL.
stdin: every headless call got < /dev/null, to skip a 3-second stdin wait.
Probes: two probe sessions (Sonnet low and Haiku, about $0.72 together) checked that a headless session waits for background subagents and tested the plugin gate; not part of any arm's cost.

Arm A run-1 logs were first written inside the arm A clone (untracked files the arm noticed and left alone); after run 1 they were moved to ~/.cache/orchestrai-ab-400/logs-A/. All later logs go outside the clones.

Arm A run 2 hit the owner's individual spend limit after 830s ($3.15). After the reset, arm A resumed through kickoff's own resume path: a new headless session (SID_A2) with the fixed prompt /tm-kickoff #411. The resumed kickoff skipped its wave-plan stop, treating the resume as the go-ahead, so no confirmation was sent. Cost covers both session ids; the limit wait is excluded from wall-clock.
Judge sessions ran with --permission-mode auto (the protocol omits a mode, and the headless default mode would deny tool calls the workflow needs); GH_CONFIG_DIR set inside env -i (see deviation 2).
Judge prompts went through stdin, because --disallowedTools takes several values and swallowed the prompt argument on the first attempt (that launch failed before any model call, no spend).

The first launch of the arm A resume failed in the shell before starting (zsh expanded opus[1m] as a glob in an eval). No model call, no spend. Relaunched through a helper script (run.sh) with the same flags.

verdict.line: INCONCLUSIVE (insufficient pairs); owner attention per task: native 0 min (4 touchpoints), pipeline 0 min (3 touchpoints)
